title: Parametrized trivial scalar cochain differential
statement: Let $P$ be a set, $G$ a group, $V$ a ring, $r\in\mathbf N$, and $c:P\times G^r\to V$ a function. The trivial-action scalar differential is the function on $P\times G^{r+1}$ given by $$(d^rc)(s;g_1,\ldots,g_{r+1})=c(s;g_2,\ldots,g_{r+1})+\sum_{a=1}^{r}(-1)^a c(s;g_1,\ldots,g_ag_{a+1},\ldots,g_{r+1})+(-1)^{r+1}c(s;g_1,\ldots,g_r).$$ In degree zero the two terms cancel, so $d^0=0$. No topology, completeness or coefficient action is required by this coordinate formula.
